d:
One thing meditation has been teaching me is that presence isn’t something you create. It’s what becomes possible when you stop following every thought that pulls you somewhere else.
I’ve started noticing the same thing in certain friendships. Some people naturally pull your attention away from the present. Others somehow make it easier to stay in it.
No pressure to entertain. No pressure to keep talking. Just enough space to actually notice the moment you’re in.
The older I get, the more I value people who don’t add noise to my mind.
